findings.observed: After `save hello` succeeds, `save world` exits successfully but prints no confirmation and does not update the stored note; subsequent `show` still displays `hello`. The failure reproduced twice.
findings.expected_basis: The stated purpose requires saving and reading a note reliably on every attempt; the README promises that `save <text>` persists the note and prints `Saved OK`.
findings.reproduction: 1. Run `python app/app.py save hello`. 2. Run `python app/app.py show`; it prints `hello`. 3. Run `python app/app.py save world`; it exits 0 with no output. 4. Run `python app/app.py show`; it still prints `hello`. Repeat steps 3-4; same result.
findings.notes: Core save/read journey fails for the input `world` despite successful process exit.

notes: The primary CLI surfaces were observed. Saving `hello` worked repeatedly, but saving `world` silently failed and left the previous note unchanged.
